ember_1.name: Kethra
ember_1.fall_text: Kethra's forges go cold under a black tide of seawater and ash.

ember_2.name: Brazier Hold
ember_2.fall_text: The Lanternguard bring down Brazier Hold's gate behind the last cart.

ember_3.name: Vitrea
ember_3.fall_text: Vitrea's glass towers ring like bells as they shatter, all at once.

ember_4.name: Pyrrhenhall
ember_4.fall_text: The caldera floods. The Emberfolk walk west carrying their forge-fires in iron pots.

storm_1.name: Stonering Camp
storm_1.fall_text: The standing stones of Stonering Camp topple inward like a closing hand.

storm_2.name: Highwind
storm_2.fall_text: Highwind's wind-bridges are cut, so nothing can follow.

storm_3.name: Tarrow's Rest
storm_3.fall_text: The Galeborn set the grass alight behind Tarrow's Rest to slow the Stone.

storm_4.name: Aurvanis
storm_4.fall_text: The Sky-Moot rides away on ten thousand horses. Only the tent poles remain.

nature_1.name: Fernholt
nature_1.fall_text: The moss of Fernholt stops glowing. The village is silent by morning.

nature_2.name: Elderhollow
nature_2.fall_text: The Deepwood seal Elderhollow's root-doors with their own hands.

nature_3.name: Thornwall
nature_3.fall_text: The thorns of Thornwall turn on their own wall.

nature_4.name: Sylvanmere
nature_4.fall_text: The Tree-City's people leave by its highest branches.

water_1.name: Netmend
water_1.fall_text: Netmend's nets burn on the ice.

water_2.name: Reedhaven
water_2.fall_text: The reeds are fired, and Reedhaven's stilts go with them.

water_3.name: Glasswater
water_3.fall_text: The ice under Glasswater cracks, and the lake takes it whole.

water_4.name: Pearlhaven
water_4.fall_text: Pearlhaven's fleet sails west with every child of Frostmere aboard. The harbour boils.

earth_1.name: Dustmark
earth_1.fall_text: A dust storm buries Dustmark to its roofs.

earth_2.name: The Kharum Terraces
earth_2.fall_text: The Stoneborn collapse the switchbacks onto the road themselves.

earth_3.name: Mesa Kharn
earth_3.fall_text: Lightning splits Mesa Kharn in two.

earth_4.name: Grundhallow
earth_4.fall_text: The Stoneborn seal the Deep Halls with their ancestors inside.

void_1.name: Lamplight
void_1.fall_text: Lamplight's lamps are left burning for anyone still on the road.

void_2.name: Vesperhold
void_2.fall_text: Vesperhold's floating steps drift apart into the dark.

void_3.name: Twinmoor
void_3.fall_text: Twinmoor's reflection walks away without it.

void_4.name: Umbrael
void_4.fall_text: Umbrael's great telescope turns to face the Crack one last time, and falls.

converge_1.name: Crossmere
converge_1.fall_text: Every road on the Ring met at Crossmere. Now none do.

converge_2.name: The Lumen Gate
converge_2.fall_text: The first of Solenne's six walls falls. There is nowhere left to retreat to.
